comment: Drivers every submission is measured against, pinned by the SHA-256 of the .so.
A score means the same thing on two phones only because the anchor is literally the
same code on both. A name or a version string is not enough: 'Turnip 25.1' can be two
different binaries, and the system driver is a different binary on every device, which
is why it can never be an anchor.
Adding an anchor is close to permanent. Every score in the leaderboard is a ratio
against one, so replacing an anchor does not adjust the numbers, it invalidates them:
the old scores measure a different thing. Retiring one means keeping its rows readable
and starting a new table, or re-measuring every entry against the replacement.
So an anchor should be a build that is: already public and downloadable at a stable
URL, reproducible from a known source revision, and unremarkable — a mid-range,
well-behaved build, not the fastest one known, because every future score is expressed
relative to it and a freak anchor makes every number harder to read.
